_설명: 게임 그림 목록. key는 파일 이름, emoji는 게임에서 이 그림으로 바꿔 그릴 이모지(없으면 코드에서 key로 씀). kind: sprite(투명 캐릭터·소품) / ui(투명 버튼) / bg(배경). ref는 그림체·생김새를 맞출 때 참고할 그림. size는 생성 크기. flop: true면 좌우를 뒤집어요(게임은 캐릭터가 왼쪽을 본다고 가정)

style.sprite: Style: cute handmade 3D clay figure for a preschool picture book app, plasticine texture with subtle fingerprints, soft rounded shapes, warm soft studio lighting, gentle pastel colors. One single object, centered, whole object visible with generous empty margin, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, isolated on a fully transparent background.
style.ui: Style: chunky glossy 3D clay game button for a preschool app, soft rounded shapes, plasticine texture, soft studio lighting, pastel colors. Single button centered with empty margin, no text or letters, no shadow on the ground, isolated on a fully transparent background.
style.bg: Style: handmade 3D clay diorama background for a preschool picture book app, plasticine texture, soft rounded shapes, warm soft lighting, gentle pastel colors, shallow depth of field. Wide landscape view, no characters, no animals, no text. Keep the center and lower middle open and uncluttered so characters can stand there.

girl.prompt: A little girl about 6 years old wearing a bright red hooded cape with the hood up, round rosy cheeks, big friendly eyes, short brown hair peeking out, simple blue dress, standing.

mom.prompt: The girl's kind young mother with brown hair in a bun, wearing a yellow apron over a green dress, warm smile, standing. Same clay style and proportions as the reference.

grandma.prompt: A sweet grandmother with a gray hair bun, small round glasses, lavender shawl over a long dress, gentle smile, standing. Same clay style and proportions as the reference.

hunter.prompt: A friendly forest woodsman with a big brown beard, green felt hat with a feather, brown vest, rolled sleeves, no weapons, cheerful smile, standing. Same clay style and proportions as the reference.

wolf.prompt: A sly, sneaky cartoon gray wolf standing on two legs, narrowed cunning eyes, wide toothy grin with two small fangs, big pointy ears, bushy tail, hunched slightly forward like he is plotting something. Scary-funny for preschoolers, not gory. The wolf faces and looks toward the viewer's LEFT side of the image (snout pointing left). Same clay style as the reference.

wolf-nightcap.prompt: The same sly gray wolf as the reference, disguised as a grandmother: frilly white nightcap, small round glasses, pink flowery nightgown, sitting up, sneaky grin. The wolf faces and looks toward the viewer's LEFT side of the image (snout pointing left).
